description: The next binary32 or binary64 value up or down. Positive zero and negative zero both step up to the smallest positive subnormal, and both step down to the smallest negative one. Infinity stays put at its end. A NaN is returned with its payload unchanged. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/float-next
name: float_next
title: Float Next
